title: Saving the River
text:
The river in our town is very dirty. Many people throw plastic bags and bottles into the water. Fish cannot live in dirty water, so there are fewer fish every year.

A group of children decided to help. They picked up rubbish from the river bank every Saturday. Now the water is cleaner, and a few fish have come back to the river.

questions.text: What do many people throw into the river?
When did the children pick up rubbish from the river bank?
Why are there fewer fish in the river every year?
options: Because the water is too cold
Because the town has no river

questions.text: What can we say about the children from the second paragraph?
options: They do not care about the environment
They live far from the river

vocabulary.definition: things that you throw away because you do not want them

paragraph_translations: Річка в нашому місті дуже брудна. Багато людей кидають у воду пластикові пакети та пляшки. Риба не може жити в брудній воді, тому з кожним роком риби стає менше.
Група дітей вирішила допомогти. Кожної суботи вони збирали сміття з берега річки. Тепер вода чистіша, і в річку повернулося кілька риб.
